Ram Temple Trust Sees Leadership Changes Amid Donation Controversy

The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Trust has accepted the resignations of key officials, including Champat Rai and Anil Mishra, amidst allegations of donation misappropriation. While some reports suggest a PMO hand in administrative changes, others highlight the trust's review of administrative posts and acceptance of resignations. Champat Rai has reportedly denied approving a cash-counting standard operating procedure and blamed the SBI for lapses.
